title: 第17章 为官之道第18章 阶级薄膜
content_zh:
徐子训站在讲台上，没有去动胡教习留下的那幅《枯荣古树图》，也没有再在空中虚画什么玄奥的符文。
他只是简单地卷起了袖口，露出一截并不算十分白皙、甚至带着几分力量感的手腕，随后指了指自己的丹田位置。
讲堂内的空气仿佛凝固了，所有人都屏住了呼吸，生怕错过哪怕一个字的震动。
“胡教习讲‘池塘’，讲‘大旱’，那是大道的意象，是高屋建瓴的指引。
但咱们**凡胎，经脉也没长眼睛，若是真把自己当池塘去旱，不懂个中分寸，多半是要出岔子的。”
徐子训的声音平稳，去掉了所有的修饰词，只剩下最干脆、最粗暴的“干货”
“所谓的‘枯’，落在实操上，就一个字——‘挤’。”
“当你们觉得元气耗尽，再也提不起一丝力气，甚至连手指都懒得动弹的时候，那是假象，那是身体趋利避害的本能在骗你。
这时候，千万别停。”
他伸出右手，虚握成拳，在空中做了一个狠狠拧转、挤压的动作，手背上的青筋随之暴起
“闭住气海穴，强行逆转小周天，把藏在经脉末梢、藏在脏腑深处的那点‘余气’，像挤湿毛巾一样，硬生生挤回丹田。”
“这个过程会很痛，像针扎，像火烧，你会浑身冷汗直冒，甚至会感到一阵濒死的眩晕。
但只要挤出来那最后的一丝，丹田就会瞬间处于真空。”
“这才是真正的‘枯’。不把自己逼到绝境，如何以此身为器，去承载更多的天地伟力？”
台下鸦雀无声，只有急促的呼吸声和笔尖划过纸张的沙沙声。
王虎手中的笔飞快地在纸上记录着，每一个字都记得极重，力透纸背，仿佛要把这法门刻进骨头里。
“至于‘荣’……”
徐子训顿了顿，目光变得柔和，语气也从凌厉转为舒缓
“很多人那是真饿极了，张口就吞，恨不得一口吃成个胖子。
错！大错特错！那是饮鸩止渴！”

“饿极的人不能暴食，枯竭的经脉更经不起暴吸。”
“这时候，要改‘鲸吞’为‘蚕食’。”
“吸三呼一，气走督脉而不走任脉。
让元气先在背后的诸阳之会暖一暖，化去那股子天地间的生涩之气，再去润泽干裂的丹田。”
一边说着，徐子训一边在自己身上比划着路线，手指从尾椎一路向上，划过脊背，越过头顶，最终温如流水般落回丹田。
动作缓慢，清晰，哪怕是毫无基础的傻子也能看懂。
“如此修来的元气，虽然慢了些，但胜在精纯，温润如玉，不伤根基。且以此法重塑后的丹田，比平日里浑厚至少三成。”
“而这三成，便是你们日后施展二级法术的底气，也是能不能考进二级院的胜负手。”
徐子训看向台下那些听得如痴如醉的学子，笑着抛出了最后也是最诱人的饵
“很多人问，为什么要拼命把《聚元决》修到更高层？不就是气多点吗？多那一点半点有何用？”
他竖起一根手指，轻轻摇了摇
“不仅仅是多。”
“是一两棉花和一两铁的区别。”
“同样是一级《唤雨术》。
聚元一层施展出来，那是松散的洒水，风一吹就散；聚元三层施展出来，那是密集的泼水，落地砸坑！
元气密度大了，法术架构就稳，损耗就小，甚至能做到‘意在气先’。”
“这便是为何内舍弟子种的地，亩产总是比外舍高数成的原因。
不是地好，也不是种子好，是气硬！”
轰！
content_en:
Xu Zixun stood on the podium and did not touch the "Picture of Withered Ancient Trees" left by Professor Hu, nor did he draw any mysterious runes in the air.
He simply rolled up his cuffs, revealing a wrist that was not very fair and even had a sense of strength, and then pointed to his Dantian.
The air in the lecture hall seemed to be frozen, and everyone held their breath for fear of missing the shock of even a single word.
"Hu Jiaoxi talks about 'pond' and 'severe drought', which are the image of the great road and the guidance of a high-level building.
But we are mortals and our meridians don’t have eyes. If we really treat ourselves as a pond and don’t know how to deal with it, something will probably go wrong. "
Xu Zixun's voice was steady, with all the modifiers removed, leaving only the most straightforward and crude "dry stuff"
"The so-called 'dry', in practical terms, is just one word - 'crowded'."
"When you feel that your energy is exhausted and you can no longer raise any strength, and you are too lazy to even move your fingers, that is an illusion. It is the body's instinct to seek advantages and avoid disadvantages that is lying to you.
At this time, don’t stop. "
He stretched out his right hand, clenched it into a fist, and made a hard twisting and squeezing motion in the air, causing the veins on the back of his hand to pop out.
"Close the Qihai point, forcefully reverse the Little Zhoutian, and squeeze the little 'remaining Qi' hidden in the ends of the meridians and deep inside the organs, like squeezing a wet towel, back into the Dantian."
“This process will be very painful, like needle pricks, like fire, you will break out in cold sweat, and you may even feel dizzy on the verge of death.
But as long as the last trace is squeezed out, the Dantian will be instantly in a vacuum. "
"This is the real 'Ku'. Without pushing yourself to a desperate situation, how can you use your body as a tool to carry more of the mighty power of heaven and earth?"
The audience was completely silent, except for the sound of rapid breathing and the rustling of the pen tip across the paper.
The pen in Wang Hu's hand was writing quickly on the paper, and every word was remembered very deeply, and it penetrated the back of the paper, as if he wanted to carve this method into his bones.
"As for 'Rong'..."
Xu Zixun paused, his eyes softened, and his tone changed from harsh to soothing.
“Many people are so hungry that they open their mouths to eat, wishing they could become fat in one bite.
Wrong! Big mistake! That's drinking poison to quench thirst! "
"People who are extremely hungry cannot overeat, and depleted meridians cannot withstand overeating."
"At this time, we need to change 'whale swallowing' to 'cannibalize'."
“Inhale three times and exhale one, the qi flows through the Du channel and not through the Ren channel.
Let the vitality first warm up in the meeting of the suns behind you, dispel the astringent energy between heaven and earth, and then moisten the dry and cracked Dantian. "
As he spoke, Xu Zixun traced the route on his body, running his fingers from the tail vertebra all the way up, across the back, over the top of the head, and finally the warmth fell back to the Dantian like running water.
The movements are slow and clear, even a fool with no basic knowledge can understand it.
"Although the vitality cultivated in this way is a little slower, it is more pure, as gentle as jade, and does not damage the foundation. Moreover, the Dantian reshaped by this method is at least 30% thicker than usual."
"And this 30% will be the confidence for you to cast second-level spells in the future, and it will also determine whether you can enter the second-level academy."
Xu Zixun looked at the students in the audience who were listening intoxicatedly, and smiled as he threw out the last and most tempting bait.
"Many people ask, why do you have to work so hard to cultivate "Ju Yuan Jue" to a higher level? Isn't it just to have more Qi? What's the use of having a little more?"
He raised a finger and shook it gently
“It’s not just more.”
"It's the difference between one ounce of cotton and one ounce of iron."
"It's also a first-level "Rain Calling Technique".
When the first level of Juyuan is used, it is a loose sprinkling of water that will scatter when the wind blows; when the third level of Juyuan is used, it is a dense sprinkling of water that hits the ground!
When the energy density is high, the spell structure will be stable and the loss will be small, and it can even be achieved that "the intention is to focus on the energy first". "
"This is why the yield per mu of land cultivated by Neishe disciples is always higher than that of Waishe disciples.The reason for the high number.
It’s not that the land is good, nor that the seeds are good, it’s that the air is hard! "
Boom!
